narr: Thunderstorms on the Fourth of July produced a strong wind gust with the Aberdeen Regional Airport Automated Surface Observing System reaching a peak of 81 mph. Heavy rainfall from these storms also led to flash flooding in Aberdeen and later in Watertown.
ev: A trained spotter reported street flooding halfway up car tires on roadways in Watertown from brief but intense rainfall. The COOP observer in Watertown recorded 1.22 inches of rainfall in 1 hour.

Rainfall intensity overwhelmed the city drainage system in Aberdeen, leading to a street closure and stranded vehicles. The Aberdeen Regional Airport ASOS recorded 1.51 inches of rainfall in an hour and a half.
